snippet.title: TRACKED: Shoot To Survive – Official Announcement Trailer | Meta Quest 3/3s
snippet.description:
You survived the crash… but the real fight starts now.

TRACKED: Shoot To Survive is a realistic VR Action-Survival Shooter set deep in the Canadian wilderness. After the drug smugglers brutally brought your plane down, survival is your only option, and your sister’s life is on the line.

Craft tools, hunt wildlife, climb and explore hostile terrain, face ruthless smugglers in a stunning, fully immersive VR experience. Every weapon, every tool, and every step feels real.

Will you find out who’s tracking you along the way?
